items.title: Brody Richter Earns CUSA Special Teams Player of the Week Honors
items.summary: DALLAS – After a career day on Saturday, Aggie punter Brody Richter has been named the Conference USA Special Teams Player of the Week for Week 11 based on a vote of media members from throughout the league.

items.title: NM State Suffers Overtime Defeat at Missouri State
items.summary: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. – NM State held a lead late into the fourth quarter, however, the Aggies were unable to exit with the victory as Missouri State used a late score to send the game into overtime where the Bears eventually defeated the Aggies 27-21.

items.title: NM State Drops Homecoming Matchup Against Liberty
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State returned to action at Aggie Memorial Stadium on Saturday night, playing in their seventh nationally televised matchup in a Homecoming contest with Liberty. items.title: NM State to Host Liberty in Homecoming Tilt
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State Football is set to return to Aggie Memorial Stadium for the second consecutive contest as it hosts Liberty on Saturday during Homecoming weekend. The matchup will mark the 10th all-time meeting between the Aggies and Flames and fourth time the two programs square off in Las Cruces. items.title: Aggies Drop Home Contest to Jax State
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – NM State returned home for its final Weekday CUSA contest of the 2026 season, falling 24-0 to Jax State on Wednesday at Aggie Memorial Stadium. NM State came away with a pair of interceptions, however, a pair of missed field goals and turnovers hurt the Aggies in the Conference USA matchup.

The battle features a pair of teams near the top of the league standings as NM State holds a 2-1 record and Jax State enters with a 3-0 mark in conference play ahead of Wednesday. items.title: Aggies Continue Conference USA Play at Sam Houston on Wednesday
items.summary: LAS CRUCES, N.M. – After a week away, the Aggies will return to action on Wednesday night as they travel to Huntsville, Texas, to square off with Sam Houston at Elliott T. Bowers Stadium. This will mark the fourth all-time meeting between the Aggies and Bearkats and will serve as NM State's second trip ever to Huntsville. Kickoff for the Weekday CUSA bout is slated for 6 p.m.

items.title: Aggies Drop Weekday Clash in Miami
items.summary: MIAMI – Playing in its second midweek game of the season, NM State returned to action on Wednesday night, taking on the FIU Panthers as part of Weekday CUSA. Behind a trio of giveaways, the Aggies recorded their lowest scoring output of the season, falling 22-3. With the loss, NM State falls to 2-4 on the season, with a 1-1 mark in Conference USA action.
